study.question: Does the pooled positive-label bit source need current-batch auxiliary prevalence at all, or does a fixed positive scalar yield the same source orientation and click utility? This is a training-only source necessity test within the strongest joint forward architecture, not a test of eliminating all auxiliary supervision.
study.hypothesis: Observation: g3-r0030-joint_replay click AUC 0.668457307890924 exceeded click-only/context-blocked 0.6678548720585206, while batch-rolled supervision fell to 0.6674639465810746. Later source-only studies are more restrictive: g3-r0071 positive-label source gave 0.6688260412608873 (+) and 0.6682300757043065 (-); cycling positives in g3-r0072 reduced the positive cell to 0.6687278997261598. In g3-r0073, broadcasting per-task prevalence retained 0.6688269831426015 (+), almost the native positive-source value. g3-r0074 pooling away task ratios gave 0.6688439850318495 (+) and 0.6680225598277424 (-), versus exact per-task bridges 0.6688269831426015 and 0.6683056393243232. All are single frozen-seed observations; no source-bit diagnostics were collected. The remaining consequential ambiguity is whether the live pooled scalar supplies information to the bit. At a fixed recipient graph, ideal BCE(c)-BCE(0) probability cotangents are c times BCE(1)-BCE(0) cotangents. Consequently g_pool=(256*c)*g_fixed for fixed target 1/256. Centering, click projection, reassignment and tangent construction are positively homogeneous, and canonical pivot sign plus the relative degeneracy gate are scale invariant for c>0 away from rounding/ties. Thus a common positive source scale should be redundant for the bit; c=0 and finite-precision cancellation are explicit exceptions. This is an analytic prediction about this implementation, not evidence that auxiliary labels or native transfer magnitude are unnecessary.

study.proposed_difference: Replace the live pooled auxiliary source target by a constant dyadic 1/256 in candidate cells only, while running both source loss graphs in every cell. After reviewing the existing receipts, choose this small dyadic constant prospectively for the next experiment; it is not an estimate of training prevalence, and no sweep or tuning is performed. Its arbitrary magnitude is a numerical-scale confound requiring the declared diagnostics. Cross source choice with aligned/reversed external transfer sign in four standalone modules. Common-scale equivalence is predicted only for positive pooled prevalence at a fixed state; record c=0 separately. Add an optional detached common_scale_bit_diagnostics helper for authorized future host probes. It is not called by the model or automatically collected by the documented host API. No forward representation, label semantics, private objective, native geometry or host recipe changes. Global originality unverified.
predictions: At fixed states with c>0 and nondegenerate source tangents, pooled cotangents should equal (256*c) times fixed cotangents within measured precision; the two source bits, transfer supports/radii and actual context VJPs should coincide or nearly coincide. Source magnitude is not the final transfer radius, which remains native true-label geometry.

If this equivalence survives the actual BF16/FP32 backward/cast path, replacing prevalence should preserve each external-sign trajectory and the pooled positive-versus-negative quality gap. This would support redundancy of live prevalence for this bit only, with true labels still present elsewhere.
Any reproducible positive-versus-negative gap under a fixed source shows that sign sensitivity alone does not establish use of current label prevalence in the source bit.

Both new pooled bridges should reproduce g3-r0074 AUC/logloss/task metrics to the deterministic replay envelope; forward values, module/state sets and private gradients should match at a fixed state. Bridge drift must be resolved before interpreting candidate quality.

Parameter count and inference computation remain identical by source structure; measured training overhead may increase slightly from three extra fixed-target BCEs per batch. Equal-pass comparisons isolate the source change; an efficiency claim needs measured cost, not inherited timing alone.
falsifiers: At c>0, systematic fixed-state bit changes with a non-negligible source-scale residual, stable non-tied pivots and matched support falsify the implemented scale-redundancy prediction; first test arithmetic and transport ordering before assigning semantic meaning.

A repeated fixed-source quality deficit relative to valid pooled bridges, at the same external sign and frozen protocol, falsifies practical substitutability in this implementation. If attributable to c=0 support or scale-sensitive rounding, it does not establish informative prevalence semantics.
Failure to reproduce the pooled bridges or a changed private gradient/forward state invalidates causal attribution; do not reinterpret that as a mechanism failure.

No bit intervention on positive-prevalence batches is expected under the analytic hypothesis. Null AUC plus identical bits is a successful redundancy diagnostic, not a broad finding that auxiliary supervision or every source intervention is irrelevant.
Without same-state diagnostics and authorized repetition, a lone validation gain/loss cannot establish scale redundancy, interference, significance or a new predictive contribution.
alternative_explanations: BCE difference cancellation, FP32 source gradient summation, BF16 edge casts, pivot ties/near ties and the inherited relative tangent degeneracy gate can make a common positive rescaling change a discrete bit.
Zero pooled-prevalence batches give a zero source bit default of +1; the fixed target stays nonzero. Their frequency and effective transfer difference must be separated from c>0 scale effects.

True labels continue to train private auxiliary modules and define native radius/line/gates; a constant immediate source can still carry accumulated label information through model state. This is not a fully label-free auxiliary-gradient control.

The bit is global, the canonical carrier is coordinate/order dependent, and Dice couples rows. Geometry is before embedding ID scatter and Adagrad; row-space orthogonality does not guarantee parameter-space noninterference.

Single-seed adaptive validation search, correlated exposures and many prior trajectories can exaggerate a small observed AUC difference. Exact same-seed bridges establish reproducibility, not independent mechanism replication.
The official offline feedback policy and 24-hour category/brand auxiliary attribution limit any production or advertisement-conversion interpretation.
